title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 901 N. Francisco Avenue, Mission, Texas, as the "Mission Veterans Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 901 N. Francisco Avenue, Mission, Texas, as the "Mission Veterans Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Mission, Texas Postal Service building the "Mission Veterans Post Office Building."
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 901 N. Francisco Avenue in Mission, Texas. The building will now be officially called the "Mission Veterans Post Office Building." It is a naming law and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 6, 2018.
